name: UEA Multivariate Time Series Classification Archive (2018)
description: The UEA Multivariate Time Series Classification Archive is a canonical benchmark repository of 30 multivariate time series datasets spanning diverse domains, including motion recognition, medical electrocardiography/EEG, audio processing, handwriting analysis, and sensor telemetry. Curated by the University of East Anglia and partners, it standardizes evaluation protocols and splits for multivariate sequence classification.
